project.title: Frontline Wellbeing & Communication Skills Program
project.objective: Design and pilot a wellbeing and communication skills program for contact centre and reception staff to reduce stress and improve service quality.
deliverables: Needs analysis report on stressors and skill gaps in frontline roles
Standardised communication and de-escalation training curriculum
Wellbeing and micro-break protocol for contact centre and reception staff
Pilot training schedule and attendance records for first cohort
Evaluation report with pre/post feedback and improvement plan
constraints: Program must fit into existing shift patterns with minimal service disruption
Content must comply with labour legislation and internal HR policies
No additional headcount; use existing staff and trainers
Pilot must cover at least two different frontline teams
Budget limited to internal time and low-cost materials only

risks.risk: Low participation due to workload and shift constraints.
risks.mitigation: Coordinate with supervisors for staggered sessions and offer multiple time slots.

risks.risk: Program content perceived as irrelevant by frontline staff.
risks.mitigation: Run quick interviews beforehand and co-create examples with supervisors.

risks.risk: Inconsistent application of new communication practices on the floor.
risks.mitigation: Provide simple job aids and brief follow-up refreshers with supervisors.

risks.risk: Wellbeing activities conflict with existing health and safety rules.
risks.mitigation: Have HR and administration review and sign off all physical activities.

themes.why_relevant: Understanding real pain points is key to designing a useful wellbeing program.
Better conversations reduce complaints and emotional strain on staff.

themes.theme: Scheduling around shifts and service levels
themes.why_relevant: Training must not harm service KPIs or leave phones unattended.
Fitness-based micro-breaks must be safe, inclusive and easy to adopt.
Need simple metrics and feedback to justify scaling the program.

backlog.task: Run quick needs analysis with frontline staff and supervisors
definition_of_done: At least 10 frontline employees and 3 supervisors interviewed or surveyed
Key stressors and skill gaps summarised in a short report
Findings shared in channel and stored in shared drive

backlog.task: Define target audience, pilot scope and selection criteria
definition_of_done: Pilot teams and headcount confirmed with supervisors
Selection criteria documented and agreed with HR
List of participants drafted and validated

backlog.task: Design communication and de-escalation training modules
definition_of_done: 2–3 modules outlined with objectives and key messages
Role-play scenarios drafted based on real calls
HR reviews content for policy and tone alignment

backlog.task: Create wellbeing and micro-break exercise plan for desks
definition_of_done: Set of 6–8 low-impact exercises documented with instructions
Exercises reviewed for safety and accessibility
Plan approved by HR and administration

backlog.task: Draft program overview and communication to participants
definition_of_done: One-page overview created with goals, agenda and expectations
Invitation template prepared for email and intranet
HR signs off wording and sends to supervisors

backlog.task: Build training schedule aligned with shift patterns
definition_of_done: Session slots proposed for all pilot participants
No slot leaves team below minimum staffing threshold
Schedule confirmed with HR and posted in channel

backlog.task: Prepare training materials and job aids
definition_of_done: Slide deck or handouts created for each module
Simple one-page job aid for communication tips drafted
Materials uploaded and links shared in channel

backlog.task: Deliver pilot training sessions and capture attendance
definition_of_done: All planned sessions delivered within pilot window
Attendance recorded for each session
Any no-shows flagged to supervisors for rescheduling

backlog.task: Collect participant feedback and quick impact metrics
definition_of_done: Short survey sent to all participants
At least 60% response rate achieved
Summary of feedback and key metrics documented

backlog.task: Document program governance and ownership for rollout
definition_of_done: Roles and responsibilities for ongoing program defined
Update and review cadence agreed with HR and supervisors
Governance note stored and shared in channel

backlog.task: Align program with labour legislation and internal policies
definition_of_done: Check against working time, breaks and equality policies completed
Any required adjustments documented and applied
Compliance note attached to program overview

backlog.task: Define simple wellbeing check-in routine for teams
definition_of_done: Short check-in script or questions drafted
Frequency and duration agreed with HR
Supervisors briefed on how to run check-ins

artifacts.title: Frontline Needs Analysis & Stressor Summary
artifacts.used_for: Capture interview notes, stressors, and skill gaps to inform program design.

artifacts.title: Pilot Program Overview & Scope
artifacts.used_for: Explain objectives, target audience, modules, and expected outcomes to stakeholders.

artifacts.title: Communication & De-escalation Job Aid
artifacts.used_for: Provide quick reference tips for handling difficult calls and customers.

artifacts.title: Desk-based Wellbeing & Micro-break Protocol
artifacts.used_for: Standardise safe, short exercises and break routines during shifts.

artifacts.title: Pilot Training Schedule & Attendance Tracker
artifacts.used_for: Plan session times and record who attended each training slot.

artifacts.title: Feedback & Impact Evaluation Report
artifacts.used_for: Summarise survey results, qualitative feedback, and recommendations.

artifacts.title: Policy & Compliance Review Checklist
artifacts.used_for: Ensure program elements comply with labour law and internal HR policies.

artifacts.title: Program Governance & Ownership Note
artifacts.used_for: Clarify who maintains content, schedules sessions, and tracks outcomes.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on pilot scope, target audience, and success criteria.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message announcing the wellbeing and communication skills program.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm which frontline teams and how many employees join the pilot.
Agree on 2–3 primary success metrics for the pilot.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Design and finalise the training modules and wellbeing protocol.
threads_plan.trigger: Sharing first draft of training topics and micro-break ideas for feedback.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Select final set of communication modules for the pilot.
Approve the desk-based wellbeing and micro-break protocol.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Lock training schedule and logistics with minimal service impact.
threads_plan.trigger: Posting the draft training schedule for review by supervisors and HR.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the final training schedule for all pilot participants.
Confirm process for handling no-shows and rescheduling.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Ensure compliance and define governance for ongoing rollout.
threads_plan.trigger: HR sharing initial policy review notes and governance proposal.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Sign off that the program complies with labour and internal policies.
Agree on long-term ownership and review cadence for the program.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Review pilot feedback and decide on adjustments before scaling.
threads_plan.trigger: Posting the draft feedback and impact evaluation report.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Decide which elements to keep, change, or drop for the next wave.

channel_rituals: Twice-weekly async check-in on pilot progress and blockers.
Weekly summary post with decisions made and next steps.
Post-session debrief thread after each training day to capture quick feedback.
End-of-pilot retrospective discussion focusing on what to improve before rollout.
